title: Introduction to SomaEnrich

However, ORA requires arbitrary cutoff define feature list. requirement, ORA can sensitive choice threshold. GSEA (case, pre-ranked) operates ranked list measured features, without applying significance cutoff. Pre-ranked GSEA evaluates whether members given gene set tend cluster toward top bottom ranked list. vignette primarily focuses GSEA requires considerations pre-processing steps SomaScan specifically. Please reference ?somaORA examples performing ORA SomaScan-derived differential expression data.
